title: County
description: A county that MAY have a page at /pickleball/us/{state}/{county}-county/. Rule 8 applies: 3 or more VERIFIED venues.

x-notes.no_counts: Rule 2: no stored tallies. See city.schema.json for why.
x-notes.name_excludes_county: name and slug hold the BARE county name, without the word County. The URL pattern appends -county and the keyword template appends County. Storing it here as well would produce Tarrant County County.

slug.description: Bare county slug. The -county suffix belongs to the URL pattern, not to this value.

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS code. The stable federal identifier, and the safest key for county derivation.
